The expert perceptual auditor noted 'moderate compression', which explains some of the texture inconsistency the Router flagged as an AI artifact. However, the boundary between whale and water shows some softness/melting consistent with the Router's observation. The overall artifact score should reflect the unnatural water physics and texture inconsistencies.
